clips.title: The story
paras: North of Auberdine, the Silver Dawning and Mist Veil lie beneath the waves. Murlocs ambushed both night elf vessels as they sailed into port, and their surviving crews seek a way to mourn their lost captains.

Murlocs overwhelmed the Silver Dawning and Mist Veil as the ships approached Auberdine. Both vessels sank in the shallows north of the settlement. Their surviving crews reached shore, but the loss of the ships and their captains weighs on the port.

Gorbold Steelhand, a dwarf in Auberdine, seeks to honor the fallen night elf captains. Murlocs now occupy the underwater wrecks, but the captains' lockboxes remain in the flooded holds. Their logs and personal effects could help the surviving sailors mourn their commanders and lay their spirits to rest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Off the coast of Darkshore to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.

Both captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done us here in Auberdine a great service, lad. We'll make sure that their effects are properly taken care of.
As for you, please have this. It is the least I can do for someone with the bravery to set things right.
